title: Health Resort east wing room 222 key

infobox.usage: Unlocks room 222 of the East wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Health Resort east wing room 222 key (E222 San) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Azure Coast sanatorium east wing room 222.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Connected to room 226 through the balcony.
- Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Shoreline
sections.text: - On a chair on the first floor of the power station

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The second floor, room 222 of the East Wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Room 222:
  - 1× Physical Bitcoin spawn (inside of the cardboard box)
  - Three weapon spawns (one RSASS, one SV-98 and one MP5)
  - 1× Weapon box (6x4)
  - 1× Weapon Rack
  - 1× Grenade box
  - 1× Toolbox
  - Loose loot Valuables
- Room 226:
  - 1× Weapon box (6x4)
  - Multiple LEDX spawns
  - 1× MP-153 spawn
  - Loose loot (Currency, Provisions, Meds, Medical supplies)
- Shared balcony:
  - 1x Weapon Locker
